name: Build Your Factory Tycoon [ALPHA]
desc:
🏭 Welcome to Build Your Factory Tycoon! 🔧

🏗️ In BYFT you claim your own plot, build a powerful factory using machines and conveyors, and turn raw materials into profit! 💰

👍 Enjoying the game? Consider giving it a thumbs up - your support helps us grow. Thank you! 🙌

⚠️ The game is still under active development — everything is subject to change. Expect bugs and frequent updates! You’ll receive an Alpha Tester badge just for playing. 🏅

💡 Hints:
• Try out different machines to discover what items they produce. 🔍
• Upgrade machines to maximize efficiency. ⏫ 
• Customize your factory's name, colors and logo by going to settings. 🎨
